description: This file defines protocols related to streaming audio playback, including methods for playing and stopping audio streams, and extensions linking these protocols to specific implementations.

methods.name: play(stream:)
methods.description: Asynchronously plays an audio stream, returning a StreamingPlaybackResult.

methods.name: stop()
methods.description: Stops audio playback and returns an optional Double value.

methods.name: play(stream:sampleRate:)
methods.description: Asynchronously plays an audio stream with a specified sample rate, returning a StreamingPlaybackResult.
